build: Pytxo Desktop 1.2.4, released MSI (administrative extract of the public mirror MSI)
agents: live vendor CLIs, signed in with their own accounts

stale_refusal.detail: A file changed after review; Apply refused with nothing written. Refresh produced a new package digest.

limits: One run on one fixture project on one Windows host. Not a benchmark or a reliability rate.
Antigravity and OpenCode were left out: in live runs Antigravity's headless mode auto-denied a tool permission and made no edits, and OpenCode's configured model could not use tools on this machine.
Passing checks is not correctness: the applied app had integration bugs (a duplicate theme button, an empty-state line shown beside matching tasks) that the agents' own tests did not cover.
Host filesystem and network controls were advisory on this run; the enforcement receipt lists which protections were enforced.
